page_title: NEW 1-0 ARS | Newcastle v Arsenal 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Arsenal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+7' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
90+5' The corner kick from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+5' The corner is swung in but Arsenal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Arsenal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
88' It must be a yellow card. It is. Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
87' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
86' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
85' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
82' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
81' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) works the corner short.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Jacob Murphy.
79' Jorginho goes off the pitch and Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) comes on.
79' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Eddie Nketiah and he is replaced by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
77' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
73' Substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ben White walks off.
73' The corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is hurriedly cleared.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Arsenal.
72' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
68' Referee Stuart Attwell points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Newcastle players celebrate.
65' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Newcastle players aren’t happy.
64' 1 - 0 Goal! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:0.
63' Here is a change. Miguel Almiron is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
62' Substitution. Callum Wilson is replaced by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
62' Declan Rice (Arsenal) covers his face with his hands after wasting a glorious chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker wide of the left post.
62' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Arsenal for a penalty. Play continues.
58' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
53' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
52' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' Declan Rice (Arsenal) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
48' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) replacing Dan Burn.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Nick Pope.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
44' A short through ball almost allows Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
42' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
41' It looks like Declan Rice (Arsenal) saw red with that tackle. Stuart Attwell won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
38' A yellow-coloured card is received by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd).
38' Booking. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) receives a caution from the referee.
37' The whistle blows and Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is booked for an infringement.
37' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) violates the laws of the game and is shown a yellow card by the referee, but it could have been a straight red as well.
35' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
32' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
31' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Stuart Attwell stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Arsenal get a free kick.
30' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
29' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Newcastle out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
28' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find Takehiro Tomiyasu, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
27' The ball is cleared after Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' The foul by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) was seen by Stuart Attwell who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
24' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
23' Arsenal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
23' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.
22' Jorginho (Arsenal) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
21' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings in a cross from the corner, but Nick Pope reads it well and gathers the ball.
20' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
20' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
19' Ben White (Arsenal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
18' It's a throw-in for Arsenal.
15' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes it short.

15' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Stuart Attwell stops the game and makes a call.
11' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
8' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
7' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but David Raya punches the ball away.
5' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes.
4' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
2' A lofted cross from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell will officiate today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
